Question B-001-007-002.

Why the correct answer is right: Amateur operators may not broadcast information to the general public.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Only when the amateur radio operator is being paid": Payment would add a commercial problem; it does not authorize broadcasting.
- sourceIndex 2: "Only when the broadcasts last less than 1 hour": A shorter duration does not change a broadcast into permitted amateur communication.
- sourceIndex 3: "Only when the broadcasts are of broad public interest": Public interest does not create a general broadcasting privilege in the amateur service.
